title: Dudu and the line
creator_credit: Steve French and Second Banana Films
brief_description: Explores the magic and fun of animation through Dudu, an ordinary little chap who encounters an extraordinary line which obeys nothing but the animator’s imagination. Suitable for middle and upper primary and lower secondary levels.
